description: This source file defines a static class 'TransactionContext' within the 'Orleans.Transactions' namespace. It manages transaction context information using AsyncLocal storage, providing methods to get, set, and clear transaction info, and throws exceptions if required transaction info is missing.

classes.name: TransactionContext
classes.description: A static class that manages transaction context information utilizing AsyncLocal storage.

methods.name: GetTransactionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the current transaction info from AsyncLocal storage.

methods.name: CurrentTransactionId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the current transaction, throws if no context is available.

methods.name: GetRequiredTransactionInfo
methods.description: Gets the transaction info, throwing an exception if it is not set.

methods.name: SetTransactionInfo
methods.description: Sets the transaction info in AsyncLocal storage.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the current transaction info from storage.
